1639 Elamites {el-am-ee'-tace}

源自希伯來文 SNH05867; 陽性名詞

欽定本 - Elamites 1; 1

1) 以攔人, 亦即在以攔省的居民, 以攔省在波斯灣以南一帶, 
   但其實際邊界則眾說紛紜 (#徒2:9|)
record.edic_text:
1639 Elamites {el-am-ee'-tace}

of Hebrew origin 05867;; n m

AV - Elamites 1; 1

1) an Elamite, i.e. an inhabitant of the province of Elymais, a
   region stretching southwards to the Persian Gulf, but boundaries of
   which are variously given
